meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
moving or capable of moving at high speed

present есть; у меня есть = I have

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
